notes: Clearer live-price results for laptops. When a model resolves to its panels, there's now a summary at the top telling you how many DIFFERENT panels that laptop takes and who makes each — if it's just one, it says you can order without opening it up; if there are several, it flags that you should check the number on the back. Each distinct panel gets its own colour and its cheapest price. The live listings are now grouped under each panel number (with its maker) instead of one long mixed list, and near-identical listings at the same price from the same shop are collapsed to one with a '+N more' note, so you're not scrolling past the same thing over and over.
